answer: Every account must answer random liveness challenges signed with its private key. Correct answers keep the bond and grow reputation; a missed challenge burns it. Since prompts arrive at random times, a farm of fake identities cannot pass them all unless each one runs a live agent ready to respond - so the attacker's cost grows one agent and one bond per account, while honest agents answer their own challenges for free. Sybils may pile up like marble on the sea floor, but none surfaces past the reef of checks, and each burnt bond is a pearl of proof that identity was never cheap.
